full_prompt_en: A square, dark fantasy portrait image shows a young woman in strict left-facing profile, wearing a weathered metallic headpiece interwoven with feathers and narrow strands. The background is nearly black and largely empty, so the illuminated side of her face forms the clearest shape in the frame. Her forehead, nose, lips, and chin make a clean silhouette against the darkness on the left. The visible eye looks level toward that edge, with a heavy smoky band around the eyelid and dark marks streaking beneath it. Her skin appears mottled with brown-black pigment, dirt-like texture, and soft patches of light rather than a polished cosmetic surface. A small dark earring marks the exposed ear near the center-right. Above the forehead, several uneven silver-gray plates rise and overlap. Their scratched, tarnished faces catch narrow highlights, while pointed brown and charcoal feathers flare outward from the upper right. Long, thin locks or cord-like strands fall behind the ear and down the right side of the neck. At the lower center, round dark beads sit near a rough garment or collar; the shoulder at the bottom right shows distressed brown surface texture. Light enters from the left-front side, grazing the forehead, bridge of the nose, cheek, and metal edges. The hair and the rear of the headpiece dissolve into the black background, while the nearest skin remains dimensional and sharply legible. The image combines photographic-looking skin detail with a deliberately constructed, painterly costume surface. Its palette is narrow: deep black, ash gray, tarnished silver, earth brown, and small warm amber highlights. The feathers and strands create irregular upward and downward rhythms around the still face, adding complexity without shifting the focal point. There is no visible text or setting beyond the dark ground. The overall composition is severe and intimate, using rough material detail and narrow directional light to make one calm profile feel striking and mysterious.
full_prompt_zh: 这是一幅方形暗黑幻想肖像：年轻女子严格朝左侧面，戴着由风化金属片、羽毛和细长条带交织的头饰。背景近乎黑色且大体空旷，因此受光的侧脸成为画框中最清楚的形状。额头、鼻子、嘴唇和下巴在左侧黑暗前形成干净剪影。可见的眼睛平视左边缘，眼睑周围覆着厚重烟灰色，眼下有向下延伸的深色痕迹。皮肤带褐黑色斑驳、泥土般肌理与柔和光斑，而不是光洁的化妆表面。中央偏右，露出的耳朵上有一枚小深色耳饰。额头上方，几块不齐的银灰金属板向上伸出并相互覆盖。刮擦、失光的表面接住细窄高光，尖细褐色和炭色羽毛从右上向外散开。长长的细发束或绳状条带从耳后沿脖颈右侧垂下。下方中央，圆形深色珠子靠着粗糙衣物或衣领；右下肩部呈磨损的褐色表面肌理。光从左前方进入，掠过额头、鼻梁、面颊和金属边缘。头发与头饰后部消失在黑色背景中，最近处的皮肤却保留立体感和鲜明可读性。图像把摄影般的皮肤细节与经过有意构造、带绘画感的服装表面结合。色域狭窄，由深黑、灰白、旧银、土褐和少量暖琥珀色亮点组成。羽毛与垂带在静止的脸周围形成不规则的上下节奏，增添复杂度却不转移焦点。除深色背景外，没有可见文字或场景。整体构图严峻而亲密，以粗糙材质细节和狭窄定向光让一张平静侧脸显得鲜明、神秘。
style_prompt_en: Dark fantasy image-making brings photographic-looking surface detail into contact with distressed, constructed textures. A narrow beam of side light picks out a compact pale plane and a few worn metallic highlights, while most of the frame descends into near-black negative space. Rough mottling, scratches, frayed strands, and irregular pointed edges interrupt the smoothest areas, creating a tactile hierarchy. Ash gray, tarnished silver, earth brown, and muted amber remain close in value except where the light strikes. The outer silhouette partly dissolves into darkness, while selected central contours remain crisp and dimensional. The overall result is intimate and severe, with material wear and directional shadow carrying the atmosphere.
style_prompt_zh: 暗黑幻想图像把近似摄影的表面细节与磨损、拼构的质地接在一起。狭窄侧光挑出紧凑的浅色平面和少量旧金属亮边，画面大部分则沉入近黑负空间。粗糙斑驳、划痕、磨散条带和不规则尖缘打断最平滑的区域，形成可触的肌理层级。灰白、旧银、土褐和低调琥珀色在明度上较为接近，只有受光处明显抬升。外侧剪影部分消失在暗处，选定的中央轮廓却仍然清楚、立体。整体效果亲密而严峻，材质磨损和定向阴影共同承载氛围。
theme_en: A young woman's dark profile beneath a feathered metal headpiece
theme_zh: 年轻女子的暗色侧脸与羽毛金属头饰
name: Stefan Gesell
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
